name: Camera Control via Euler Angles (Pitch/Yaw)
aliases: Camera View Matrix and Vector Generation
Scene Rotation via Elevation and Azimuth
definition: Computes a camera's forward direction and position updates using two rotation angles (x-rotate, z-rotate) without roll, based on aircraft principal axes.
summary: Camera Control via Euler Angles computes orientation using yaw and pitch to reduce computational cost and avoid roll, differing from full Euler rotation and quaternions.
